title: Azura Passenger Information — Final Customer Release

sections.heading: Welcome aboard Azura
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D passenger guide, not affiliated with P&O Cruises. Always follow current onboard signs and crew instructions.

sections.heading: Official ship information
sections.body:
Official P&O Cruises Azura overview and interactive deck plans (internet required): https://www.pocruises.com/cruise-ships/azura/overview
Official Azura deck plan PDF (internet required): https://www.pocruises.com/content/dam/po/inventory-assets/ships/AZ/Azura-Deck-Plan-W26-27.pdf
Check current official information and onboard signage before relying on any deck or venue details.

sections.heading: Dining
sections.body: Azura dining options may include Oriental, Peninsular, Meridian, Venezia, Verona, Sindhu and The Glass House. Availability, menus, reservations and charges may change; check onboard.

sections.heading: Entertainment
sections.body: Check the daily programme for Playhouse Theatre, Manhattan and Malabar events, along with other ship activities.

sections.heading: Deck navigation
sections.body: The in-app ship orientation is a simplified schematic, not an official numbered cabin or muster plan. Deck 5 is P Deck, 6 is F Deck, 7 is Prom Deck, 8 is E Deck, 9 is D Deck, 10 is C Deck, 11 is B Deck, 12 is A Deck, 14 is Riviera Deck, 15 is Lido Deck, 16 is Aqua Deck, 17 is Sun Deck, 18 is Ocean Deck and 19 is Sky Deck. Use the latest official deck plan for cabin positions, accessible routes and muster information.

sections.heading: Pre-cruise checklist
sections.body: Check passport and travel requirements, luggage labels, embarkation instructions, insurance and boarding time.

sections.heading: Port visits
sections.body: Record port plans in My Cruise. Always check ship time, local time and the official all-aboard deadline.

sections.heading: Offline use and backups
sections.body: Open the app online at least once before relying on offline use. Your personal records stay on this device; back them up before clearing browser data.

sections.heading: Information and advertisements
sections.body: Public information and adverts can be updated by the publisher using the repository JSON files. Updates require an internet connection.

sections.heading: Dining reservations and dietary needs
sections.body: Check your dining allocation and any reservation requirements after boarding. Speciality dining may carry an additional charge. Tell the restaurant team about allergies or dietary needs; do not rely solely on this independent guide.

sections.heading: First day aboard
sections.body: Keep your boarding documents handy, follow the muster/safety instructions, locate your cabin and identify the nearest lift or stair access. Check the daily programme for opening times and activities.

sections.heading: Sea-day planning
sections.body: Use My Cruise to record shows, meals, activities and meeting times. Check the onboard daily programme for changes and allow extra time to move between venues.

sections.heading: Going ashore
sections.body: Confirm the official all-aboard time and whether the port uses tenders. Check local versus ship time, carry required documents and keep emergency contact information from the ship.

sections.heading: Accessibility and family facilities
sections.body: Ask the ship team about accessible routes, lift availability, family facilities and activity requirements. Some venues and facilities may require advance booking.

sections.heading: Sharing Azura
sections.body: Use the Share App page to share the correct published Azura link or QR code. An internet connection is needed when someone opens the link for the first time.

sections.heading: Last-day and disembarkation checklist
sections.body: Check your onboard account, luggage collection instructions, transfer arrangements and final disembarkation information. Keep medication, travel documents and essentials in your hand luggage.

sections.heading: A note on prices and schedules
sections.body: Dining availability, opening hours, entertainment, onboard charges and drinks-package terms can change. This independent app is a planning aid and does not provide live reservations or official safety instructions.
